about_the_game:
Greetings, aquarium visitors! First of all, we would like to say a massive thank you to everyone who downloaded the original free-to-play version of The Aquarium does not dance! Thanks to your support, TADND has surpassed 600,000 downloads since its initial release in February 2024.

To show our appreciation, our team has put together this free Character Talk DLC available for everyone who downloads The Aquarium does not dance. This bonus content DLC was written by daidai specially for the release of TADND Special Edition for Steam and Nintendo Switch™. Enjoy some light-hearted banter between the characters of The Aquarium does not dance that you won't find anywhere else!

■ In more exciting news... ■

A Character Talk DLC (SP edition) is also available for everyone who purchases The Aquarium does not dance Special Edition!

This bonus DLC features special illustrations of the five heroines in pajamas and swimwear that were initially revealed at Comiket, so don't forget to check it out.

■How to View the DLC

This DLC is provided as a PDF file.

Please view it with your preferred PDF viewer.

The files are located in the ""AquadoDLC_free"" folder

within the main game directory, with versions available in each language.

■How to Open the DLC Files

(1) Open your library and right-click the "Aquarium Never Dances" icon.

(2) Select "Manage" from the context menu.

(3) Choose "Browse local files."

(4) Open the "AquodoDLC_free" folder and view the PDF with your browser or PDF viewer.
